about: Known-good and known-bad motion each CHECK threshold was tried on (I3). Every case is real measured or authored motion from this repository, with the tool arguments it becomes and the verdict a person reached. The suite replays every case; a threshold change that flips one fails the build. Leg lengths marked assumed are the reference adult hip height (0.530 x 1750 mm), because the clips record no leg length.

cases.label: known_good
cases.source: an internal motion trial (speed_mps 1.3475, stride_m 1.617, cycle_s 1.2, stance_s 0.633, slide mean 0.287 / 0.276 cm/s); final loop, approved for a showcase
